drag.","source_id":"37c151f5-eb8a-488b-b668-6e84d017878e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"By the early 1920s, gay men and lesbians were holding events of their own floor:","source_id":"37c151f5-eb8a-488b-b668-6e84d017878e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"'Men danced with women in men's clothes.","source_id":"37c151f5-eb8a-488b-b668-6e84d017878e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"And strange androgynous couples careened about the floor, oblivious to the workings of society and nature.' Today Webster Hall is a popular, mostly straight nightclub.","source_id":"37c151f5-eb8a-488b-b668-6e84d017878e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"In 2020 and 2021 the park itself became an illegal — and very raucous — after-hours dance party for Covid-weary young people from every corner of the city.","source_id":"8f51b641-6b57-47a4-8757-f83b741cf036","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Clashes between the revelers and noise-weary neighbors finally pushed police to enforce a 10pm curfew.","source_id":"8f51b641-6b57-47a4-8757-f83b741cf036","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"That curfew has since been lifted.","source_id":"8f51b641-6b57-47a4-8757-f83b741cf036","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"That's the walk — a patch of the city where the dancing never really stopped.","source_id":"GLUE_CLOSING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1}]}
